Path to the cached master file CACHE_PATH = Path("intermediate/Utah_Census_All_Counties_All_Ages_2000_2023.csv") # --- 2. Fetch & Cache (The "Extract" Phase) --- if not CACHE_PATH.exists(): print(f"Fetching Universe to {CACHE_PATH}...") decennial_years = [2000, 2010, 2020] acs_years = [y for y in range(2009, 2024) if y not in decennial_years] data_frames = [] for year in sorted(decennial_years + acs_years): try: if year in decennial_years: dataset = "dec/dhc" if year == 2020 else "dec/sf1" code_col = "DHC" if year == 2020 else "SF1" else: dataset, code_col = "acs/acs5", "ACS" year_codes = var_crosswalk[code_col].tolist() rename_map = dict(zip(year_codes, var_crosswalk["Label"])) df = get_census( dataset=dataset, variables=["NAME"] + year_codes, year=year, params={"for": "county:*", "in": "state:49"}, return_geoid=True, ) df = df.rename( columns={c: "NAME" for c in df.columns if c.upper() == "NAME"} ) df = df.rename(columns=rename_map) valid_cols = ["NAME"] + var_crosswalk["Label"].tolist() df = df[df.columns.intersection(valid_cols)].copy() df["Year"], df["Dataset"] = year, dataset data_frames.append(df) print(f"Fetched {year}") except Exception as e: print(f"Skipping {year}: {e}") if data_frames: CACHE_PATH.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) pd.concat(data_frames, ignore_index=True).to_csv(CACHE_PATH, index=False) ``` ::: ::: {#9fd91a94 .cell execution_count=6} ``` {.python .cell-code} TARGET_COUNTIES = [ "Box Elder County", "Weber County", "Davis County", "Salt Lake County", "Utah County", ] # --- 3. Load & Process (The "Transform" Phase) --- df_universe = pd.read_csv(CACHE_PATH) df_universe["Geography"] = df_universe["NAME"].str.split(",").str[0] df_wfrc = df_universe[df_universe["Geography"].isin(TARGET_COUNTIES)].copy() target_ages = ["18 and 19 years", "20 years", "21 years", "22 to 24 years"] target_cols = var_crosswalk.loc[ var_crosswalk["Age"].isin(target_ages), "Label" ].tolist() df_wfrc["Population_18_24"] = ( df_wfrc[target_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0).sum(axis=1) ) df_college_age_hist = ( df_wfrc.pivot_table( index="Year", columns="Geography", values="Population_18_24", aggfunc="sum" ) .reset_index() .rename_axis(None, axis=1) ) df_college_age_hist ``` ::: ### Timeseries Data from NHGIS ::: {#fetch-ipums-nhgis .cell execution_count=7} ``` {.python .cell-code} import os import zipfile from pathlib import Path from dotenv import load_dotenv from ipumspy import IpumsApiClient, AggregateDataExtract, TimeSeriesTable # Load authentication load_dotenv() IPUMS_API_KEY = os.getenv("IPUMS_API_KEY") if IPUMS_API_KEY: client = IpumsApiClient(IPUMS_API_KEY) # 1. Define the Time Series Table # B57 is the "Persons by Age [18]" table ts_table = TimeSeriesTable( name="B57", geog_levels=["county"], years=[ "1970", "1980", "1990", "2000", "2010", "2020", "2006-2010", "2007-2011", "2008-2012", "2009-2013", "2010-2014", "2011-2015", "2012-2016", "2013-2017", "2014-2018", "2015-2019", "2016-2020", "2017-2021", "2018-2022", "2019-2023", "2020-2024", ], ) # 2. Build the Extract Request # Geographic extent "490" represents Utah (FIPS 49 with trailing 0 as per IPUMS spec) extract = AggregateDataExtract( collection="nhgis", description="Utah County College Age Time Series", time_series_tables=[ts_table], geographic_extents=["490"], tst_layout="time_by_column_layout", # Matches the wide CSV structure ) # 3. Submit and Wait print("Submitting extract to IPUMS NHGIS...") client.submit_extract(extract) print(f"Extract submitted. ID: {extract.extract_id}") print("Waiting for extract to complete (this may take a few minutes)...") client.wait_for_extract(extract) # 4. Download and Extract download_dir = Path("data/NHGIS") download_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) client.download_extract(extract, download_dir=download_dir) zip_path = download_dir / f"nhgis{extract.extract_id:04d}_csv.zip" extract_folder = download_dir / f"nhgis{extract.extract_id:04d}_csv" print(f"Unzipping to {extract_folder}...") with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as zip_ref: zip_ref.extractall(extract_folder) print("IPUMS NHGIS Fetch Complete!") else: print("Error: IPUMS_API_KEY not found in .env file.") ``` ::: ::: {#process-nhgis-data .cell execution_count=8} ``` {.python .cell-code} # 1. Load Data # Dynamically find the latest NHGIS time-series CSV (Supports both manual and API extracts) nhgis_files = sorted(Path("data/NHGIS").rglob("*_ts_nominal_county.csv")) if nhgis_files: nhgis_path = nhgis_files[-1] # Grabs the latest one (e.g. 0003 over 0002) else: # Fallback to hardcoded if path structure differs nhgis_path = "data/NHGIS/nhgis0002_csv/nhgis0002_ts_nominal_county.csv" df_nhgis = pd.read_csv(nhgis_path) # Keep rows where State is "Utah" df_ut = df_nhgis[df_nhgis["STATE"] == "Utah"].copy() # 2. Select Target Columns target_prefixes = ["B57AE", "B57AF", "B57AG", "B57AH"] value_cols = [ c for c in df_ut.columns if any(c.startswith(p) for p in target_prefixes) and not c.endswith("M") ] for col in value_cols: df_ut[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_ut[col], errors="coerce") # 3. Melt df_long = df_ut.melt( id_vars=["COUNTY"], value_vars=value_cols, var_name="Variable", value_name="Population", ) # 4. Parse Year df_long["Suffix"] = df_long["Variable"].str[5:] df_long["Year"] = df_long["Suffix"].apply( lambda x: int(x) if len(x) == 4 else 2000 + int(x[:2]) ) df_long["Type"] = df_long["Suffix"].apply( lambda x: "Decennial" if len(x) == 4 else "ACS" ) # 5. Filter (Decennial Priority) mask_drop = ((df_long["Year"] == 2010) & (df_long["Type"] == "ACS")) | ( (df_long["Year"] == 2020) & (df_long["Type"] == "ACS") ) df_clean = df_long[~mask_drop].copy() # 6. Aggregate df_agg = df_clean.groupby(["COUNTY", "Year"])["Population"].sum().reset_index() df_agg["Geography"] = df_agg["COUNTY"].apply( lambda x: x if "County" in str(x) else str(x) + " County" ) # 7. Pivot target_counties = [ "Box Elder County", "Weber County", "Davis County", "Salt Lake County", "Utah County", ] df_college_age_hist = ( df_agg[df_agg["Geography"].isin(target_counties)] .pivot(index="Year", columns="Geography", values="Population") .reset_index() ) df_college_age_hist.columns.name = None ``` ::: ### Forecast: Kem C. Gardner Policy Institute ::: {#48460122 .cell execution_count=9} ``` {.python .cell-code} # Table 1: Utah School-Age and College-Age Population df_gpi_state_forecast = ( pd.read_excel( "data/GPI/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.xlsx", sheet_name="Table 1", header=[51, 52], nrows=41, ) .dropna(axis=1, how="all") .pipe( lambda d: d.set_axis( [ "Year", "Total_Population", "School_Total", "School_Abs_Growth", "School_Growth_Rate", "School_Share", "College_Total", "College_Abs_Growth", "College_Growth_Rate", "College_Share", ], axis=1, ) ) ) # Table 3: College-Age Population with Change by County df_gpi_county_forecast = pd.read_excel( "data/GPI/SchColAgeFS-Dec2022.xlsx", header=129, nrows=30 ).dropna(axis=1, how="all") ``` ::: ::: {#a093f4a6 .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} wftdm_counties = [ "Box Elder County", "Weber County", "Davis County", "Salt Lake County", "Utah County", ] df_gpi_projections = pd.read_excel( "data/GPI/Gardner-Policy-Institute-State-and-County-Projections-2025-2065-Data.xlsx", sheet_name="Demographic Detail", header=3, nrows=1230, ).query("Geography in @wftdm_counties")[["Geography", "Year", "Population Ages 18-24"]] ( df_gpi_projections.pivot( index="Year", columns="Geography", values="Population Ages 18-24" ) .rename_axis(None, axis=1) .reset_index() ) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=8} ```{=html}

Standardize & Combine # Rename RTP column to match IPEDS df_enroll_rtp19 = df_enroll_rtp19.rename(columns={"UOFU": "UofU"}) # Combine sorted by Year df_enroll_combined = pd.concat( [df_enroll_rtp19, df_enroll_ipeds], ignore_index=True ).sort_values("Year") # 2. Reshape to Long Format df_enroll_long = df_enroll_combined.melt( id_vars=["Year"], var_name="Univ_Code", value_name="Enrollment" ).dropna() # 3. Map to Full University Names univ_name_map = { "BYU": "Brigham Young University", "ENSIGN": "Ensign College", "SLCC": "Salt Lake Community College", "UofU": "University of Utah", "UVU": "Utah Valley University", "WSU": "Weber State University", "WESTMIN": "Westminster College", } df_enroll_long["University"] = df_enroll_long["Univ_Code"].map(univ_name_map) ojs_define(data_enroll_trend=df_enroll_long.to_dict(orient="records")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: ```{ojs} //| label: fig-enrollment-trend //| fig-cap: "Historical Fall Enrollment by University (1990-2023)" Plot.plot({ marks: [ Plot.ruleY([0]), Plot.line(data_enroll_trend, { x: "Year", y: "Enrollment", z: "University", stroke: "University", strokeWidth: 3, tip: false }), Plot.text(data_enroll_trend, Plot.selectLast({ x: "Year", y: "Enrollment", z: "University", text: "University", textAnchor: "start", dx: 8, fill: "var(--bs-body-color)" })), Plot.tip(data_enroll_trend, Plot.pointerX({ x: "Year", y: "Enrollment", title: d => `${d.University}\nYear: ${d.Year}\nStudents: ${d.Enrollment.toLocaleString()}`, fill: "var(--bs-body-bg)", stroke: "var(--bs-body-color)" })) ], marginLeft: 60, marginRight: 180, width: 850, color: { legend: true }, y: { grid: true, label: "Fall Enrollment" }, x: { tickFormat: "d" }, style: { backgroundColor: "transparent", color: "var(--bs-body-color)", fontFamily: "sans-serif", fontSize: "12px" } }) ``` # Forecast Enrollment ## Regression Analysis & Verification ::: {#304dc97e .cell execution_count=13} ``` {.python .cell-code} # --- 1. Prepare Data for Regression --- # Independent Variables (X): County Populations (Wide Format) X_hist = df_college_age_hist.set_index("Year").sort_index() predictors = X_hist.columns.tolist() # Dependent Variables (y): Enrollment (Wide Format) # Use .last() to prefer IPEDS data over RTP data for overlapping years (1997-1999) y_hist_all = df_enroll_combined.groupby("Year").last().sort_index() # Filter universities that exist in our mapping or are known keys universities = [ c for c in y_hist_all.columns if c in univ_name_map.keys() or c in ["UOFU", "WSU", "UVU", "SLCC", "BYU"] ] # Merge to ensure alignment (Inner join on Year) df_train_master = y_hist_all.join(X_hist, how="inner", rsuffix="_pop") # --- 2. Train Models & Validate --- model_metrics = [] model_fit_data = [] trained_models = {} # Store models here for the Prediction step for univ_code in universities: # Filter valid data for this university (Drop NaNs) subset = df_train_master[[univ_code] + predictors].dropna() if subset.empty: continue X = subset[predictors] y = subset[univ_code] #
